title: Bake manifest of one cluster (brief section 7)
description: One file per cluster: bake/manifest/<cluster>.json (e.g. C1.json). Geometry in panel px of the COMFORT G20 layout (R 335 dials) unless 'frame' says otherwise. Validate with: python bake/src/validate_manifest.py bake/manifest/C1.json

R.description: dial radius (px) the files were rendered for; dial clusters only

generator.description: the one command that regenerates every file of this manifest

composition.description: the proposed merge of this cluster's layers into the images the theme would load

z.description: stack position (bottom = small); section 6.2 numbering for dials, fractions allowed (5.1, 5.2)

frame.description: panel: x, y, w, h in panel px; dial: in R units of the cluster's dial (procedural entries only)

scale.description: file px per panel px (0.5 = an @0.5x file covering w x h panel px)

file.description: relative to apps/f30_cluster/hud/baked/; null for procedural / dynamic entries

bytes_by_8wh.description: file width * file height * 8 (0 when no file)

stack_below.description: ids this layer sits ABOVE (they are below it)

stack_above.description: ids this layer sits BELOW (they are above it)

dir_deg.description: math degrees: 0 right, 90 up, 135 upper left

fit.description: copy of qc.py's 'fit' (+ its ref / roi / sheet)

params.description: numeric parameters that reproduce the element procedurally, in R units / cw12 degrees
